description.value: The BX Press Cidery is a craft cider producer rooted in a third-generation transitional organic apple orchard outside Vernon, BC. The operation is currently rebranding to 'Cambium Cider Co' and opening a new farm-to-table restaurant celebrating local purveyors alongside its artisan cider. The 70-year-old Spartan apple trees and generational farming heritage give this destination a distinctive sense of place.
